newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Polaris, Grand Cathay set Taiwan debut warrants.
newsitem.headline: Polaris, Grand Cathay set Taiwan debut warrants.

text.p: The Taiwan Stock Exchange said on Tuesday Polaris Securities and Grand Cathay Securities proposed to issue stock warrants on the exchanges' Yageo Corp and a basket of five construction shares.

The Polaris Securities will issue 35 million American-style call warrants on a basket of five Taiwan construction shares, including Cathay Construction, Pacific Construction, BES Engineering Corp, China Petrochem, and Walsin Lihwa, company officials said.
Grand Cathay Securities will issue 22 million units of American-style call warrants on Yageo Corp, exchange officials said.
The warrants would be listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange after the exchange's final approval, officials said.
The trading of stock warrant is the latest derivative to be introduced to Taiwan's liberalising financial market.
Both companies' warrant strike prices will be based on Wednesday's closing prices.
